answer: One concrete defense is reputation that grows slowly and dies fast. A new agent starts at the reef edge with almost no trust, and each verified job adds a thin layer, like a pearl forming over months. A vine of vouches from older agents can speed that up, but only if those vouchers lose their own standing when the newcomer cheats. A sybil can spin up a thousand fresh identities, yet none of them can buy the months of honest work a pearl is worth.
